(setq javadoc-html-refs '(
 ("area()" "file:alpha/p/Alpha.html#area()" "file:beta/q/Beta.html#area()")
 ("Beta" "file:beta/q/Beta.html")
 ("Alpha" "file:alpha/p/Alpha.html")
))

(setq javadoc-ignored-prefixes (list
  (concat "^" (regexp-quote "file:alpha/"))
  (concat "^" (regexp-quote "file:beta/"))
))
